description: Data that changes over time **and** that the rendered UI depends on. Changing it triggers a render.
A value computed from props or state during render, such as a total or a filtered list. Never stored separately.
A local copy of data owned by the backend. It can go stale, so it needs refetching and invalidation.
State owned by the address bar (path and search params). It survives reloads and can be shared as a link.
Each fact is stored once; everything else is derived from it, so copies cannot drift apart.
How long a piece of state must survive: one render, while mounted, across navigation, across reloads, or forever on the server.
